domains.name: UI and UX Development (Reactive Web Apps)

exam_rules: Closed-book. Online proctored. No reference materials.
id_requirements: OutSystems Training account required. Government-issued photo ID for proctored exams.

lifecycle.summary: OutSystems still sells the OutSystems 11 associate developer exam, now titled without the word 'Reactive': its certification catalogue lists 'Associate Developer (O11) 120 minutes ... The Associate Developer exam focuses on the fundamentals of OutSystems 11 web and mobile application development. Targeted at developers who are new to OutSystems 11 and develop simple web and mobile applications' at '$200 US', with 'Schedule the exam when you feel ready'. No page on the issuer site announces a retirement of the 'Associate Reactive Developer' title.

official_study_resources.notes: Free online learning at OutSystems Training
official_study_resources.title: OutSystems Training

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. Renew by retaking the current exam version.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period. Full exam fee for retake.

testing_centers.notes: Online proctored exam via OutSystems platform
